title: Find several elements
summary: find_elements returns a list of all matches. It is different from find_element, which returns one match.
introduction: find_elements returns a list of all matches. It is different from find_element, which returns one match. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: find_elements returns a list of all matches. It is different from find_element, which returns one match.

blocks.code:
from urllib.parse import quote from selenium import webdriver from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By driver = webdriver.Chrome() try: driver.get("data:text/html;charset=utf-8," + quote('
  • Moon
  • Ocean
')) assert len(driver.find_elements(By.TAG_NAME, "li")) == 2 finally: driver.quit()

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: An empty result list is different from a single element not being found.
